Priya (ACME): Hey team — after our IDP secret rotation last night ~10% of users are stuck in a reauth loop. Web UI shows spinning reauth, CLI calls fail with 401. Happening across regions. Can we investigate?

Sam (Support): Sorry you're hitting this — can you paste a curl repro or a session refresh response?

Priya (ACME): Repro steps: 1) Login via SSO, 2) wait a few minutes, 3) try to call API or reload app -> gets redirected to silent /auth/refresh that returns 401. Curl: ```curl -v -H "Cookie: session=eyJ..." https://app.redwood.example.com/api/v1/session/refresh``` Response: ```HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "invalid_grant",
  "error_description": "refresh token revoked or invalid"
}```

Sam (Support): Got it. Are users seeing a full re-login prompt if they clear cookies?

Priya (ACME): Yes clearing cookies & re-login fixes it, but we can't ask all users to do that. Some mobile clients never hit the full login flow (silent refresh only) so they stay broken.

Alex (SRE): Pinged the IDP logs — I see a spike of refresh_token_revoke events tied to the client secret rotation at 02:12 UTC. Looks like the rotation invalidated refresh tokens issued prior to rotation as expected. The problem is our session refresh path treats refresh failure as a silent refresh and retries, which ends up looping because the browser prevents showing the interactive auth due to SameSite + iframe behavior on embedded flows.

Kevin (Eng): Reproduced locally: when /api/v1/session/refresh returns 401 with body {error: "invalid_grant"}, frontend does a silent iframe retry. If iframe is blocked (SameSite=None but cross-site constraints), the browser suppresses redirect -> app just keeps trying. CLI gets immediate 401.

Kevin (Eng): Minimal repro for backend: ```# simulate revoked refresh token
POST /internal/refresh-token-check HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost
Cookie: session=revoked

-> returns 401 {"error":"invalid_grant","desc":"refresh token revoked"}```

Sam (Support): Short-term mitigation for ACME: 1) ask users to clear cookies or do a full logout+login, or 2) disable silent refresh for the tenant so they get redirected to interactive login (we can toggle per-tenant). Which do you want?

Priya (ACME): Please disable silent refresh for our org, ASAP. We prefer users to be forced to reauth than be stuck.

Alex (SRE): Doing toggle now. Also pushing a runbook: if IDP rotates secrets, we should mark all existing refresh tokens for that client as expired and force full reauth flows (not silent). But we also need better UX to surface a clear 'please re-login' modal instead of a spinner.

Kevin (Eng): Proposed long-term fix: update refresh handler so that when we detect an idp "invalid_grant" semantics we: 1) return a 401 with header X-Force-Interactive-Auth: true for web flows, 2) for SDK/CLI return 401 with body {reauth_required: true, reauth_url: "https://..."}. That way clients can present a prompt instead of retrying. I'll open PR.

Sam (Support): Can you add a short-term patch to stop infinite iframe retries? Even a capped retry counter will avoid the loop while the toggle is enabled.

Kevin (Eng): Yep, adding a 3-attempt cap and on 401 invalid_grant we immediately surface the interactive flow. Draft PR: https://git.redwood/infra/PR/4521 (in review).

Alex (SRE): Deployed tenant toggle for ACME and cleared any server-side sticky session entries for their users. Confirmed mobile client still sees 401 until re-login, but web users now get a clear login modal instead of spinner.

Priya (ACME): Thanks — web behavior looks better. Mobile team will push an app update to handle reauth. Any postmortem items?

Sam (Support): Action items: 
- Kevin: land PR to add X-Force-Interactive-Auth header + retry cap (ETA 1 day).
- Alex: add automated check in post-rotation playbook to set tenant toggle and send email to affected customers (ETA immediate for playbook, email template done).
- Product: consider UX change for showing reauth modal vs spinner in SPA.

Kevin (Eng): Also adding a log line so we can query occurrences of invalid_grant post-rotation: `metric:idp.invalid_grant.post_rotation`

IDP-Bot: Noted: rotation event id=rot-2026-03-17-0212, affected_clients=[acme-client-id].

Priya (ACME): Appreciate the quick turnaround. We'll monitor and escalate if anything else shows up.

Sam (Support): Closing here once PR is merged and toggle is documented. :thumbsup:
